'''Jeremes Kelton''' was a Veteran [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Alliance Army/Legends|Army]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
